questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not correct'?
explanation: Incorrect is correct - I-N-C-O-R-R-E-C-T. The prefix IN means not. Incorrect means not correct. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'before time'?
explanation: Premature is correct - P-R-E-M-A-T-U-R-E. The prefix PRE means before. Premature means happening too early.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'full of beauty'?
explanation: Beautiful is correct - B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L. The suffix FUL means full of. Beautiful means having beauty.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'able to be read'?
explanation: Readable is correct - R-E-A-D-A-B-L-E. The suffix ABLE means able to be. Readable means able to be read.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to do again'?
explanation: Redo is correct - R-E-D-O. The prefix RE means again. Redo means to do something again.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'state of being happy'?
explanation: Happiness is correct - H-A-P-P-I-N-E-S-S. The suffix NESS means state of being. Double P and double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'between nations'?
explanation: International is correct - I-N-T-E-R-N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. The prefix INTER means between. International means between nations.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'against the law'?
explanation: Illegal is correct - I-L-L-E-G-A-L. The prefix IL means not. Illegal means against the law. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'one who teaches'?
explanation: Teacher is correct - T-E-A-C-H-E-R. The suffix ER means one who. A teacher is one who teaches.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'across the ocean'?
explanation: Overseas is correct - O-V-E-R-S-E-A-S. The prefix OVER means across. Overseas means beyond the sea.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not possible'?
explanation: Impossible is correct - I-M-P-O-S-S-I-B-L-E. The prefix IM means not. Impossible means not possible. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'without fear'?
explanation: Fearless is correct - F-E-A-R-L-E-S-S. The suffix LESS means without. Fearless means without fear. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not responsible'?
explanation: Irresponsible is correct - I-R-R-E-S-P-O-N-S-I-B-L-E. The prefix IR means not. Irresponsible means not responsible. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to write'?
explanation: Manuscript is correct - M-A-N-U-S-C-R-I-P-T. The root SCRIB means to write. A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to see'?
explanation: Visible is correct - V-I-S-I-B-L-E. The root VIS means to see. Visible means able to be seen.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to hear'?
explanation: Audible is correct - A-U-D-I-B-L-E. The root AUD means to hear. Audible means able to be heard.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to carry'?
explanation: Portable is correct - P-O-R-T-A-B-L-E. The root PORT means to carry. Portable means able to be carried.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'half a circle'?
explanation: Semicircle is correct - S-E-M-I-C-I-R-C-L-E. The prefix SEMI means half. A semicircle is half a circle.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to write before something'?
explanation: Prescribe is correct - P-R-E-S-C-R-I-B-E. The prefix PRE means before. To prescribe means to order in advance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'many languages'?
explanation: Multilingual is correct - M-U-L-T-I-L-I-N-G-U-A-L. The prefix MULTI means many. Multilingual means speaking many languages.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to break'?
explanation: Fracture is correct - F-R-A-C-T-U-R-E. The root FRACT means to break. A fracture is a break in something solid.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'light'?
explanation: Luminous is correct - L-U-M-I-N-O-U-S. The root LUMIN means light. Luminous means emitting or reflecting light.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to lead'?
explanation: Conduct is correct - C-O-N-D-U-C-T. The root DUCT means to lead. Conduct means to direct or manage.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'below the ground'?
explanation: Subterranean is correct - S-U-B-T-E-R-R-A-N-E-A-N. The prefix SUB means under. Subterranean means existing below the surface. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'state of being free'?
explanation: Freedom is correct - F-R-E-E-D-O-M. The suffix DOM means state of. Freedom is the state of being free.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to rule'?
explanation: Government is correct - G-O-V-E-R-N-M-E-N-T. The root GOVERN means to rule. Government is the system for ruling a country.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'against infection'?
explanation: Antiseptic is correct - A-N-T-I-S-E-P-T-I-C. The prefix ANTI means against. Antiseptic prevents infection.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to live together'?
explanation: Symbiosis is correct - S-Y-M-B-I-O-S-I-S. The prefix SYM means together. Symbiosis is a relationship where two organisms live and benefit together.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to speak'?
explanation: Eloquent is correct - E-L-O-Q-U-E-N-T. The root LOQU means to speak. Eloquent means expressing ideas clearly and powerfully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'wrongly judged'?
explanation: Misjudged is correct - M-I-S-J-U-D-G-E-D. The prefix MIS means wrongly. Misjudged means to have judged incorrectly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'time'?
explanation: Chronological is correct - C-H-R-O-N-O-L-O-G-I-C-A-L. The root CHRON means time. Chronological means arranged in order of time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'water'?
explanation: Hydraulic is correct - H-Y-D-R-A-U-L-I-C. The root HYDR means water. Hydraulic relates to water-based pressure systems.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'across continents'?
explanation: Transcontinental is correct - T-R-A-N-S-C-O-N-T-I-N-E-N-T-A-L. The prefix TRANS means across. Transcontinental means crossing a continent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'state of being perfect'?
explanation: Perfection is correct - P-E-R-F-E-C-T-I-O-N. The suffix ION means state of. Perfection is the state of being perfect.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'outside the ordinary'?
explanation: Extraordinary is correct - E-X-T-R-A-O-R-D-I-N-A-R-Y. The prefix EXTRA means beyond. Extraordinary means beyond what is ordinary.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'earth'?
explanation: Terrestrial is correct - T-E-R-R-E-S-T-R-I-A-L. The root TERRA means earth. Terrestrial relates to the land or Earth. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not match'?
explanation: Mismatched is correct - M-I-S-M-A-T-C-H-E-D. The prefix MIS means wrongly. Mismatched means not correctly paired.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'life'?
explanation: Biography is correct - B-I-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. The root BIO means life. A biography is a written account of someone life.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'one who practices medicine'?
explanation: Physician is correct - P-H-Y-S-I-C-I-A-N. The suffix IAN means one who practices. A physician is a medical doctor.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'circular motion'?
explanation: Revolution is correct - R-E-V-O-L-U-T-I-O-N. The root VOLV means to roll or turn. Revolution means a full circular turn or a major change.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'star'?
explanation: Astronomy is correct - A-S-T-R-O-N-O-M-Y. The root ASTRO means star. Astronomy is the science of stars and space.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'sound'?
explanation: Acoustic is correct - A-C-O-U-S-T-I-C. The root ACOU means sound. Acoustic relates to sound and hearing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'against bacteria'?
explanation: Antibiotic is correct - A-N-T-I-B-I-O-T-I-C. The prefix ANTI means against. Antibiotics kill or prevent bacteria.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not regular'?
explanation: Irregular is correct - I-R-R-E-G-U-L-A-R. The prefix IR means not. Irregular means not regular. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to understand wrongly'?
explanation: Misunderstand is correct - M-I-S-U-N-D-E-R-S-T-A-N-D. The prefix MIS means wrongly. Misunderstand means to interpret incorrectly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'full of joy'?
explanation: Joyful is correct - J-O-Y-F-U-L. The suffix FUL means full of. Joyful means full of joy or happiness.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'before birth'?
explanation: Prenatal is correct - P-R-E-N-A-T-A-L. The prefix PRE means before. Prenatal means relating to the period before birth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'after the event'?
explanation: Postscript is correct - P-O-S-T-S-C-R-I-P-T. The prefix POST means after. A postscript is a note added after the main text.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to look at again'?
explanation: Review is correct - R-E-V-I-E-W. The prefix RE means again. To review means to look at something again.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to breathe'?
explanation: Respiration is correct - R-E-S-P-I-R-A-T-I-O-N. The root SPIR means to breathe. Respiration is the process of breathing.
